title: unique(key=...) keeps the last duplicate instead of the first
body: `unique(items, key=None)` in `collectionutil/dedupe.py` is documented to drop duplicates while keeping the *first* occurrence of each item, in the original order. Two items are duplicates when `key(item)` is equal (or the items themselves, without `key`). With `key`, it currently returns the last item of each group. It should return the first item of each group, positioned where that group first appeared, and accept any iterable, including a generator.
